title: Final Electric Field
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the electric field both inside and outside the sphere.

title: Final Magnetic Field
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the magnetic field both inside and outside the sphere.

title: Induced Electric Field
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the induced electric field correctly during the demagnetization process.

title: Torque Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must compute the torque exerted on the sphere due to the induced electric field accurately.

title: Angular Momentum Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The student must explain where the angular momentum comes from during the demagnetization process.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes in the expressions for electric and magnetic fields.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid omitting any necessary factors in the torque or angular momentum calculations.
